STEP 5 OF 20

Event Category
EVENT SETUP

What this is: Event Category tells the app what kind of event you are planning.

Why you use it: Use it so the planning language and optional prompts match the event instead of assuming every event is the same.

What to do now: Choose the category that most closely matches the event you are planning.

What happens next: The category suggests suitable capabilities; it does not save until you create or update the event.

Practical example: Birthday, Bridal Shower, Wedding, Workshop, Food Showcase, Cultural Experience, Corporate Event, Party, Private Event, and Other are normal choices.
